events.verdict: Green (GSW) brings his hands forward as he establishes himself in a screening position in Smith Jr.'s (HOU) path and the contact is marginal.
Smith Jr. (HOU) grasps and then quickly releases Green's (GSW) jersey during the pick.
Brooks (HOU) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
The ball is loose when the shot clock expires and Golden State is correctly called for 24-second violation.
Green (GSW) maintains a legal defensive position as he guards Sengun (HOU) in the post.
Sengun (HOU) rests his hand on Green's (GSW) back during the rebound and the contact is marginal.
Curry (GSW) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Brooks (HOU) grasps and then quickly releases Kuminga's (GSW) right arm and does not prevent him from reaching the pass.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: The ball is last touched by Kuminga (GSW) before going out of bounds.
Curry (GSW) steps backwards and inadvertently makes contact with VanVleet (HOU) as he moves off of the ball.
Green (GSW) initiates contact with his right hand to Sengun's (HOU) front/right arm prior to Sengun's gather. A non-shooting foul is correctly whistled.
Sengun (HOU) and Green (GSW) briefly engage and disengage in the lane.
Kuminga (GSW) legally contests Smith Jr.'s (HOU) jump shot attempt.
Podziemski (GSW) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Looney (GSW) maintains a legal guarding position during Sengun's (HOU) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Curry (GSW) releases away from Brooks (HOU) front as he steps back and Brooks' momentum continues to carry him backward.
Looney (GSW) places a hand on Sengun's (HOU) back and immediately slides it off during the rebound.
VanVleet (HOU) and Payton II (GSW) make incidental contact with each other in pursuit of the loose ball.
VanVleet (HOU) makes clean contact with the ball as Payton II (GSW) makes the pass.
Kuminga (GSW) reaches over Green (HOU) in an attempt to get to the ball and pulls his shoulder down.
Podziemski (GSW) does not inbound the ball within five seconds.
Smith Jr. (HOU) cleanly blocks Podziemski's (GSW) jump shot attempt prior to incidental contact occurring.
